objects.name: Detection technique coverage: windows-impair-defense-deny-security-software-with-applocker
objects.description: The following analytic detects modifications in the Windows registry by the Applocker utility that deny the execution of various security products. This detection leverages data from the Endpoint.Registry datamodel, focusing on specific registry paths and values indicating a "Deny" action against known antivirus and security software.
